solo.speaker: Dr. Nova (Data Architect)
solo.title: What crowdsourcing is

turns.speaker: Dr. Nova
turns.text: Crowdsourcing obtains input, services, or resources by soliciting contributions from a large group, typically through an online community. It draws on collective intelligence and diverse skills for problems that are too complex or time-consuming for a small team alone. The approach can lower cost while also tapping creativity, not only routine labor.
